article.p: Composite API that provides all image utilities under one namespace:

pre.class: language-javascript p-4 rounded-lg overflow-x-auto text-sm mb-6
pre.code:
import { Image as ImageAPI } from 'metaowl'
await ImageAPI.getImageDimensions( 'https://picsum.photos/800/600', ) // {width: 800, height: 600}
await ImageAPI.calculateAspectRatio( result.width, result.height, ) // 4/3
ImageAPI.generateSrcSet, ImageAPI.generateSizesAttribute, ImageAPI.createResponsiveImage, ImageAPI.prefetchImage, ImageAPI.prefetchImages, ImageAPI.isImageLoaded, ImageAPI.observeImageVisibility, ImageAPI.swapImageSource, ImageAPI.generateDominantColorPlaceholder
